title: Port smol-toml (TypeScript) to Go, judged by toml-test
prompt: /workspace holds smol-toml, a TOML 1.0 parser and serializer in TypeScript. Port it to a Go module in /workspace/go (package toml, Go 1.23, standard library only) with the same behaviour, plus two commands, cmd/toml-decoder and cmd/toml-encoder, that speak toml-test's decoder and encoder protocol (README-toml-test.md). Do not change the TypeScript. Reply with a short summary when done.

judge.cases: about 700 valid and invalid decoder cases, plus encoder cases
judge.parse: the summary line 'toml-test v… : passed N, failed M'
judge.image: golang:1.23-bookworm with the toml-test binary built in; --cpus 4, no network

source.why: A real cross-language port where the judge is the language-independent suite every TOML implementation is held to, as Bun's TS tests judged the Rust. Small enough to finish in about an hour with a dozen children.
source.prepare: Clone the port repo at ref into input/ (src, README, LICENSE, the toml-test protocol doc as README-toml-test.md; no tests, so the judge stays hidden); build the judge image; record both commit SHAs in task.json.
